name: Maralen

timeline.summary: Oona creates a duplicate Maralen and gives it a piece of her soul to preserve her memories.
timeline.quote: she created a duplicate Maralen, a Mornsong elf, and instilled this duplicate with a piece of her soul

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane to Shadowmoor, a coalition of Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys, a kithkin named Brigid, a merrow named Sygg, a flamekin named Ashling, and a treefolk sapling named Colfenor.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen becomes queen of the fae and binds herself to Rhys with a death pact.
timeline.quote: Maralen took on the mantle of queen of the fae and bound herself to Rhys with a death pact.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: The faerie drops a sprig of foxglove on the sleeping Maralen's pillow.
timeline.quote: dropping its sprig of foxglove onto the pillow of the figure sleeping there.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen wakes from a terrible dream, sensing something is very wrong.
timeline.quote: With a gasp, Maralen awoke and sat upright in her bed

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Camey reports that the faerie Aherin is missing and that someone is using his bed, making the flock seem to number thirty-five.
timeline.quote: But now there are thirty- four of us, and Aherin is missing

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhys visits Maralen, who is reminded of the pact by which he would kill her if she followed Oona's path.
timeline.quote: Should she show any sign that her slow transformations had started to lead her down her creator's path, Rhys would kill her

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen briefly sees a third figure of living flower petals in her mirror and hears ghostly laughter, which Rhys cannot hear.
timeline.quote: it looked like there was a third person in the room with them, smaller, made entirely of living flower petals and glaring at her with unending menace.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen flees to the courtyard to find comfort with Eirdu.
timeline.quote: Hello, old friend,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: As Eirdu leaves, patches of Shadowmoor open in the courtyard, and the blue faerie transforms back to green and follows Maralen.
timeline.quote: letting its transformation repeat in reverse, blue becoming green, smoothness becoming jagged and ornate.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The students explain how they arrived; Brigid identifies the creature as a faerie and says she is a close friend of Queen Maralen.
timeline.quote: I'm sort of a close friend of their queen.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen finds petals of Oona's flesh in her chamber and realizes her independence may be unraveling.
timeline.quote: These were the petals of Oona's flesh, and they couldn't be here, unless—

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen sees Oona's gaze in the mirror and hears laughter.
timeline.quote: she met the terrible gaze of Oona and pushed herself away from the mirror so hard

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Faeries bring Tam and Sanar to Maralen, and Tam says Brigid sent them.
timeline.quote: I'm a gorgon. My name is Tam—Brigid sent us.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen tells the students Oona is returning and she does not know if she can stop her.
timeline.quote: Oona is returning, and this time, I don't know if I can stop her.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhys bursts in with the blue faerie and attacks Maralen with a dagger to keep his promise.
timeline.quote: The elf drew a dagger from his belt and lunged.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen explains the death pact and flees with Tam, Sanar and the blue faerie before Rhys returns.
timeline.quote: But I'm not ready to die, and if we can settle Isilu and restore the cycle, I may not have to.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen, Sanar and Tam escape the palace by blowing the bud off a giant stem with Sanar's improvised explosive and sliding down it.
timeline.quote: The bud exploded, sending sticky chunks flying in all directions.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen finds a hidden coracle and the trio drifts toward the Wanderwine; Maralen explains Oona was her creator and she must prove she is not her.
timeline.quote: But I'm still myself.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen explains she keeps Rhys alive by magic through their binding promise.
timeline.quote: As long as he's bound to me, my magic keeps him alive.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The coracle reaches the Stinkdrinker Warren, where Ashling pulls Maralen ashore.
timeline.quote: A four-fingered hand made of what looked like flexible black glass caught her wrist and tugged her onto solid ground.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen tells Ashling their story, and Ashling reveals the elves and Morcant plan to kill the night beast with poisons.
timeline.quote: They're concocting a plan to kill the creature.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen rejects ending the night forever, saying eternal day is Oona's way, and Ashling agrees to help stop the elves.
timeline.quote: Eternal day is Oona's way, not my own.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen, Tam, Sanar and Ashling set out down the Wanderwine in a boggart-crewed boat, and Maralen tells of Oona's great aurora.
timeline.quote: she managed to capture the auroras that naturally flare between night and day and braid them into a single great aurora

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen reveals she was made by Oona as a weapon-avatar and slipped into the skin of Maralen of the Mornsong.
timeline.quote: I was to be her avatar, a part of her, carrying her consciousness ahead of my own.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen tells of her older brother, Oona's first avatar, who defied her, befriended a giant he called father, and vanished after Oona had the giant killed.
timeline.quote: The first was my brother.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Shadowmoor claims the Wanderwine and the boggarts refuse to go farther, forcing the group to walk.
timeline.quote: Shadowmoor had taken the Wanderwine.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Ashling steps into Shadowmoor and becomes rimekin, retaining her memory.
timeline.quote: By night, I'm what we call 'rimekin,'

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The transformed kithkin of Goldmeadow led by Brigid surround and herd the party.
timeline.quote: the transformed Brigid at the front of their pack.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Isilu approaches with a small green faerie flitting before it, and Maralen recognizes it as her brother.
timeline.quote: My brother,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen greets the faerie as her brother, but it flits back to Isilu.
timeline.quote: You came home!

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen explains that her brother was made a shapeshifter and the blue faerie was his Lorwyn self.
timeline.quote: The blue faerie that accompanied us was his Lorwyn self, and unfamiliar to me.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Sanar hits an elf archer with a rock and defiantly tells the elves to back off.
timeline.quote: We just want to go home

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhys approaches Maralen with a poisoned dagger, calling her Oona.
timeline.quote: I made your heir a promise. I made my friend a promise. This ends now.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhys cuts Maralen's arm; she bleeds petals and collapses, and Rhys is stunned that she did not fight back.
timeline.quote: the wound bled petals in place of blood

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The faerie drops to the ground, grows into a tall winged man and confronts Rhys, declaring Oona dead and Maralen his sister.
timeline.quote: Oona is dead. Maralen was my sister

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Oko recounts leaving Oona and mistaking Maralen for Oona reborn, and Rhys learns the poison has sealed her fate.
timeline.quote: His knife was coated in moonglow.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Oko demands Ajani save his sister and tells him the magic of the plane is fed by story and that only saving the queen will save Tam.
timeline.quote: The magic of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor is fed by story,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Oko vows not to fail his sister and drips dawnglow into Maralen's mouth.
timeline.quote: What a cruel world, to force one such as I to play the hero,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen revives, swallowing the dawnglow under her own power as the wound's petals turn to golden sap and then ordinary blood.
timeline.quote: This time Maralen swallowed under her own power, and her eyes fluttered open

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Oko tells Rhys that Maralen is not Oona reborn and spares him, since Rhys thought he was destroying a tyrant.
timeline.quote: You thought you were destroying a tyrant, and that, at least, I can respect.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Isilu and Eirdu answer each other's calls and, instead of fighting, wrestle in play; Maralen declares the balance is here.
timeline.quote: Then Isilu returned the bow and pounced.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen thanks Oko for returning and tells everyone the night elemental awoke because the strangers' dreams hurt it.
timeline.quote: The night elemental awoke because your strange dreams hurt it.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen forgives Rhys, but realizes his old promise is gone and he is no longer bound to her magic.
timeline.quote: Your old one—I can't feel it anymore. You're no longer bound to my magic.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhys thanks Eirdu and Maralen, then dissolves into flower petals and dies.
timeline.quote: His body came apart in flower petals, dawnglove and moonglove and apple blossom

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Oko declines to stay and rule, but Maralen offers him a home in Glen Elendra.
timeline.quote: But I love my freedom too much to be confined.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen, originally an avatar of Oona, becomes steward of the plane from Glen Elendra.
timeline.quote: Originally an avatar of Oona, Maralen is now the steward of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor alongside Eirdu and Isilu
